meta.title: Kosher Private Meat Chef at Home for Events Across Israel | Ameaty Grill
meta.description: Ameaty Grill is Yonathan Assouly's kosher private meat chef service: live grill, table service and an alcohol bar for friends' parties, birthdays, Sheva Brachot and Bar Mitzvahs anywhere in Israel. He brings all the equipment. Get a quote on WhatsApp.
meta.ogAlt: Yonathan turning meat on the grill over the coals

whatsapp.hello: Hi Yonathan, I found you through the Ameaty Grill website and I'd like to talk about an event.

hero.eyebrow: PRIVATE CHEF · KOSHER MEAT · ALL ISRAEL
hero.title: The real grill, at your place
hero.text: A kosher private meat chef who shows up with his grill, his coals and his meat, and cooks right in front of your guests.
hero.video: Skewers and beef ribs grilling over the coals

manifesto.title: Real meat, cooked in front of you, over real coals.
manifesto.text: In Hebrew, “amiti” means real. That's the whole idea: carefully chosen kosher meat, coals lit on site, and a chef who slices, flames and serves while your guests enjoy themselves. You host, I handle the fire.

pillars.title: What I bring to your place

items.name: Live grill
items.label: On the fire, in front of your guests
items.text: The grill goes in your garden, on the terrace or in the hall. Entrecôte, ribs, skewers: everything comes off the coals the moment it's eaten.

items.name: Table service
items.label: Seated, boards and plates
items.text: For a dinner, the meat comes to the table: carpaccio, sliced boards, a blowtorch flambé right in front of you. Your guests stay seated and the show comes to them.

items.name: Bar & extras
items.label: To keep the night going
items.text: An alcohol bar with a bartender, glasses and service, plus a few extras depending on the event. Available with every package.

items.title: Quote on WhatsApp
items.text: A direct reply from the chef

steps.name: We talk
steps.text: A WhatsApp message or the form: the date, the place, how many guests.

steps.name: We plan
steps.text: We pick the package and the menu together, and I send you a clear quote.

steps.name: I show up
steps.text: On the day, I arrive with the grill, the charcoal, the meat and all the gear.

steps.name: You enjoy
steps.text: You stay with your guests. I take care of the fire, the service and the clean-up.

chef.title: Yonathan Assouly
text: Ameaty Grill is me: Yonathan, a kosher private meat chef who comes to your home and to your events anywhere in Israel.
I love the moment the coals are ready, the first cut hits the grill and the guests start drifting towards the fire. My job is to make that moment last all night.
chef.video: Entrecôte steaks searing on the grill

gallery.title: The coals, the meat, the table

reviews.title: They say it better than I do
reviews.empty: Reviews from my clients are coming here soon. In the meantime, their nights are on Instagram.

area.title: All of Israel
area.text: I travel all over the country: to your home, a garden, a hall or a terrace.

items.label: Where
items.value: Anywhere in Israel. Travel costs depend on the distance and are listed in the quote.

items.label: Kashrut
items.value: Kosher meat only. Tell me your requirement in your request.

items.label: Equipment
items.value: I bring the grill, charcoal, boards and tools.

items.a: Yes, all the meat is kosher. If you need a specific certification (Rabbanut, Mehadrin, Badatz), add it to your request and I'll confirm what's possible.

items.q: What do I need to have at home?
items.a: An outdoor or well-ventilated spot for the grill, and that's about it. I bring the grill, charcoal, boards and tools.

items.q: What's the minimum number of guests?
items.a: It depends on the package: a table dinner works for small groups, a live grill is built for crowds. Each package shows its minimum.
Anywhere in Israel. Any travel cost is clearly listed in the quote.

items.q: How do I book a date?
items.a: Fill in the form or message me on WhatsApp. We set the menu together, then I hold the date for you.

quote.title: Tell me about your event
quote.text: A few details, the message opens in your WhatsApp, and I get back to you with a quote.
